mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (near zero) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.25% (t-test p > 0.05 compared to baseline).

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0) reflects a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based consumer sector contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when both HOUST < 700 and RSAFS < 400000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO < 95.0) signals reduced industrial output and weak economic growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings face downward pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO falls below 95.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 700) signals a weakening housing market that reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when HOUST falls below 700 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of near-zero interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.25) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0) indicates a liquidity trap where monetary policy is ineffective, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when both FEDFUNDS < 0.25 and UNRATE > 8.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Weak retail sales (RSAFS < 400000) indicate reduced consumer spending and economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when RSAFS falls below 400000 (t-test p > 0.05).
